comments.text: The fact that so many families chose to return and rebuild says a lot about their connection to Barbuda. For anyone from the island, what made you want to come home? 🤨🤨🤨

comments.text: What really gets me is that the people of Barbuda are standing up for something money can’t replace. An island’s land, traditions, and sense of community are worth far more than a price tag. I admire that kind of determination.
